findings.message: accesses system or user credential stores
findings.remediation: Avoid direct access to credential files; use authenticated API flows instead.
findings.impact: Direct access to system credential stores allows theft of SSH keys, AWS creds, and Docker tokens.
findings.risk_adjustment: No automatic downgrade: risk changes require explicit protective controls.

findings.message: constructs a regular expression from a non-literal value (possible ReDoS)
findings.basis: OWASP Regular Expression Denial of Service Prevention
findings.remediation: Use bounded, allowlisted patterns and enforce input and execution limits for dynamic regular expressions.
findings.impact: An attacker-controlled regular expression can consume excessive CPU and deny service.
findings.attack_vector: A non-literal value is passed to RegExp without pattern or execution bounds.
findings.risk_adjustment: No automatic downgrade: risk changes require explicit protective controls.

findings.message: passes a private, loopback, or link-local address to a network API
findings.remediation: Allowlist public destinations and reject loopback, RFC1918, and link-local targets before making requests.
findings.impact: Requests to private or loopback addresses can reach internal services that are not publicly exposed.
findings.attack_vector: A network API receives a literal RFC1918, loopback, or link-local URL without an allowlist check.
findings.risk_adjustment: No automatic downgrade: risk changes require explicit protective controls.

findings.remediation: Require explicit user approval and use a fixed allowlisted command with bounded arguments.
findings.downgrade: Downgraded from high: no system-impact pattern matched near the call site.
findings.impact: Attackers can execute arbitrary OS commands on the host, leading to full system compromise.
findings.attack_vector: Plugin spawns a child process with attacker-controlled arguments; no user approval gate.
findings.risk_adjustment: Explicit risk (medium) set by caller; evidence-based risk adjustment skipped.
